description:
CLN_CCS case-control study inputs for a VBC.

Permissive superset (every field optional). Captured; the scoring
(OR > 5.0 → +4.0; CI including 1.0 → no points; OR ≤ 1.0 → benignity) and
the exclusivity rule (other CLN codes NA except CLN_DNV) are documented,
not computed.

case_cohort_size.description: Number of unrelated cases in the cohort (SM 4 recommends >= 100).
case_cohort_size.title: Case Cohort Size

case_variant_count.description: Observations of the VBC in the case cohort (SM 4 recommends >= 5).
case_variant_count.title: Case Variant Count

ci_lower.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval around the OR.
ci_lower.title: Ci Lower

ci_upper.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval around the OR.
ci_upper.title: Ci Upper

control_cohort_size.description: Number of individuals in the control cohort.
control_cohort_size.title: Control Cohort Size

controls_matched.description: Whether cases and controls were matched (ancestry, sequencing platform, QC) per SM 4.
controls_matched.title: Controls Matched

odds_ratio.description: Odds ratio for the VBC's enrichment in cases vs controls.
odds_ratio.title: Odds Ratio

title: CaseControlStudyEvidence
